download_intro_text: One app for heat and calving detection: AI Detector. Download it for your computer, open it, and setup continues in your browser. Choose your system below for the step-by-step guide.
download_card_windows_desc: For PCs with Windows 10 (22H2 or newer) or Windows 11. Uses an NVIDIA graphics card automatically when you have one.
download_card_macos_desc: For Macs with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) and macOS 14 or newer. Very quiet and energy-efficient.
download_card_linux_desc: Ubuntu package, Docker container for a PC with an NVIDIA GPU, or an NVIDIA Jetson Orin edge computer.
download_how_text: Whatever system you choose, the installation always ends the same way: setup opens in your browser and guides you through three short steps — cameras, detection and start.
